component.name: KiraWavTar
component.summary: Combine multiple audio files into one and extract them back

description.p: KiraWavTar combines multiple WAV and FLAC audio files into a single file with metadata, enabling batch audio editing workflows. Combine your files, apply effects in a DAW, then split them back out — preserving original formats and metadata.

ul.li: Combine WAV and FLAC files into a single audio file
Extract individual files back with original format preservation
Support for multiple container formats: RIFF WAV, RF64, W64, and FLAC
Configurable sample rate, bit depth, and channel count
DC offset removal and high-quality resampling
Multi-volume archive support for large collections
